meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂目标拆解成有依据的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂目标不知如何拆分
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex goals into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to break down complex goals

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把大目标拆成小步骤，每步都要求可核对的证据才继续，并全程记录进度。它会启动后台助手并行干活，最后按既定规则停止交付。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”或“ulw”等词，或要求执行需要证据检查的长期任务时，该技能会启动工作流程。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个项目目标拆成步骤并执行。
say.note: Claude 会先读工作流，注册目标并开始分解。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式做证据导向的长期交付，需要手动 QA。
say.note: 它会启动后台助手，并逐步记录证据。

say.text: 帮我检查这个功能的完成度，以检查点方式推进。
say.note: 它会按停止规则和证据记录判断完成情况。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude works in a goal-loop manner: it breaks a large goal into small steps, requires observable evidence for each step before proceeding, and tracks progress. It may spawn background subagents for parallel work and records state in the ulw-loop CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or asks for evidence-led, checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break this project goal into steps and execute.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow, registers the goal, and starts decomposing.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode for evidence-led long-term delivery with manual QA.
say_en.note: It launches subagents and records evidence per step.

say_en.text: Check the completion of this feature using checkpoints.
say_en.note: It applies stop rules and evidence to judge done.
